verdict.rationale: The evidence only mentions an "Invoice Coding Agent" that automatically codes bill line-items with AI, which is a narrow, single-purpose automation rather than a general-purpose in-app AI assistant users can delegate arbitrary tasks to. Missing for 10: evidence of a conversational or task-delegation AI assistant embedded in the product UI, examples of users assigning varied tasks to it, and any first-party documentation describing assistant capabilities beyond bill coding.
